author: KEXP
description: The debut from Arizona-based group By Storm finds rap innovators RiTchie and Parker Corey continuing on a mission to transform hip-hop. In-studio with DJ Prometheus Brown, the duo share a performance of "Dead Weight" and more from 'My Ghosts Go Ghost.'
title: By Storm performs "Dead Weight" & more Live on KEXP
